items.title: Anthropic 提交 Form S-1 招股书，计划在纳斯达克上市
items.summary: Anthropic 已向美国证监会（SEC）提交 Form S-1 注册声明，计划在纳斯达克全球精选市场进行首次公开募股，股票代码拟定为 "ANT"。

evidence.quote: Anthropic files S-1 with the SEC for proposed initial public offering Published Oct 26, 2026 Category Announcements Today, Anthropic, PBC filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with the U.S.
Securities and Exchange Commission relating to its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.

Anthropic intends to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “ANT.” The number of shares of Class A common stock to be offered and the price range for the proposed offering have not yet been determined.

items.title: 腾讯混元开源 Hy-SimulMT-30B-A3B，支持中英双向实时同传与声音克隆
items.summary: Tencent Hunyuan 推出的 Hy-SimulMT-30B-A3B 是一款实时同传模型，支持中英双向语音到语音翻译与实时声音克隆。在 RealSI 长音频评测中，其 StreamLAAL 约为 3 秒，在同类对比系统中表现领先。

evidence.quote: Hy-SimulMT is a real-time simultaneous translation model developed by Tencent Hunyuan, supporting bidirectional speech-to-speech translation between Chinese and English .
It continuously receives incoming audio and translates as the speaker talks, producing both translated text and speech.
With real-time voice cloning , it preserves the speaker's vocal characteristics while conveying the message accurately.
In our RealSI long-form audio evaluation , Hy-SimulMT achieved a StreamLAAL of approximately 3 seconds , the lowest among the systems shown in the comparison.

items.title: NVIDIA 开源 SkillSpector：用于扫描 AI 智能体技能的安全工具
items.summary: NVIDIA 推出的 SkillSpector 是一个针对 AI 智能体技能的安全扫描工具，可在安装前检测 Claude Code、Codex 和 MCP 等技能中的漏洞、提示词注入及供应链风险。

evidence.quote: SkillSpector Public Notifications You must be signed in to change notification settings Fork 2k ( 2k ) Star 22.4k ( 22.4k ) You must be signed in to star a repository About Security scanner for AI agent skills.
Detect vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, security risks, prompt injection, data exfiltration, and supply-chain risks in Claude Code, Codex, and MCP skills before you install them.

items.title: Hob：开源的本地端 Claude 与 ChatGPT 桌面替代方案
items.summary: Hob 是一个开源且支持离线运行的桌面应用，可在 Mac、Windows 和 Linux 上本地运行开源权重模型，并提供文件读写、沙箱 Python 代码执行及内置网页搜索等功能。

evidence.quote: A free, open-source alternative to Claude and ChatGPT that runs open-weight models like Gemma and gpt-oss locally on Mac, Windows and Linux.
Private, and works offline.
Fill out PDFs, work through documents, and much more.
Hob picks the best frontier open-weight model that fits your computer and sets everything up for you.

items.title: RynnUnify：面向具身智能的 16B 统一具身大脑模型
items.summary: 来自达摩院等机构的研究团队推出了 RynnUnify，这是一个 16B 的统一具身模型，通过交错的视频-语言推理将具身理解、长远视觉规划和机器人控制结合在一起。

evidence.quote: hao , Siteng Huang , Leigang Qu , Sicong Leng , Dongchi Huang , Mingxiu Chen , Shijian Lu , Yue Wang , Xiaodan Liang , Zhenyu Zeng , Deli Zhao , Chengju Liu , Jianfei Yang + 1 authors Abstract RynnUnify is a 16B unified embodied model that integrates visual planning, physical reasoning, and robot co

Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small We introduce RynnUnify, a 16B unified embodied model that combines strong embodied understanding with long-horizon visual planning through interleaved video--language reasoning.
We also develop a world-action extension of the full RynnUnify model, translating its understanding and prediction capabilities into robot control .

items.title: RSIHub：用于智能体进化方法的开源可组合框架
items.summary: 字节跳动等机构的研究人员推出了 RSIHub，这是一个用于构建、比较和扩展智能体进化方法的开源框架。该框架通过共享基础设施和可复用算子，支持在固定模型和评测配置下对不同进化策略进行评估。

evidence.quote: Wang , Kai Wu , Mengnan Qi , Kai Cai , Xiaodong Gu , Zilong Zheng Abstract RSIHub is an open-source framework that standardizes agent-evolution research by providing shared infrastructure for building, comparing, and extending methods with reusable components and consistent evaluation.
We present RSIHub , an open-source framework for building, comparing, and extending these methods on shared infrastructure.
Recipes compose reusable operators and declare mutable resources ; RSIHub supplies execution, evaluation, recovery, and lineage .
We evaluate them with MiniSWE and Codex on Terminal Bench 2 and τ^3 Banking under fixed model and evaluator configurations.

items.title: TWIG：将神经网络权重统一表示为共享离散决策路径的新方法
items.summary: ITMO 大学生研究团队提出了 TWIG 权重表示法，将神经网络的每个权重视为离散决策路径的终点，从而统一了剪枝、量化和低秩分解等多种模型压缩方法，并在大语言模型上实现了更高效的推理与存储。

evidence.quote: Papers arxiv:2610.31931 Copy markdown Every Weight Is a Path of Shared Discrete Decisions Published on Oct 22 · Submitted by Ammar Ali on Oct 26 · ITMO University Upvote 20 +12 Authors: Ammar Ali , Stamatis Lefkimmiatis Abstract TWIG represents neural network weights as shared discrete decision path

Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small We introduce TWIG ( Tree-structured Weights with Inherited Gates ), a representation in which every weight of a neural network is the end of a path of small discrete decisions : a sign, a shift by a power of two, a zero gate , an index into a shared table.
Pruning , quantization , low-rank factorization , codebooks and weight sharing become edits of one object, so a single optimizer can choose among all of them for a whole network.

items.title: Hugging Face transformers v5.21.0 发布，新增 MiniCPM-OCR 等多个模型支持
items.summary: Hugging Face transformers 发布 v5.21.0 版本，新增了 MiniCPM-OCR、Flint、UltraVBert 等模型支持，并改进了缓存处理与张量并行配置。

evidence.quote: Release: v5.21.0
MiniCPM-OCR is a document-understanding model from OpenBMB's MiniCPM-V family.
Flint is Recursive's mixture-of-experts language model.
UltraVBert extends ModernVBert by pairing the UltraBERT text encoder with a SigLIP vision encoder for visual document understanding and retrieval.
